question: How should the lord be contemplated during oblations with mustard-oil-smeared materials?
premises: The oblation uses materials smeared with mustard oil.
The lord is the object of contemplation.
The lord should be contemplated in a tamas-natured form.
inference: During oblations with mustard-oil-smeared materials, one should contemplate the lord in his tamas-natured form.
plain_english: In an oblation with materials smeared with mustard oil, one should meditate on the lord in his tamasic form.
